line_why: The carrier, coming at the camera bow on, swings its bow to the right so its deck turns from a wide front view into a long diagonal with the port side showing; frame 45 is where that diagonal first reads. Frames 0-24 are the near-still approach (with the bow drifting from slightly left to dead centre as the small counter-move before the turn), 27-42 build the swing, 48-49 carry it on.
